filter_note.note: Friday of Week 5, final injury reports day. Loudest rooms DAL (TNF upset loss to TB), CHI (Mike Ditka death, Bagent at Lambeau), TB, GB, PHI, BAL, NE, NO. Status-heavy: Lamar out for SNF at ATL (Huntley starts, Hendrickson/Jurgens out), Eagles without Barkley/Smith/Brown in London, Chargers without James/Alt/Johnston and Slater to IR, Bosa out and not traveling, Chase/Higgins questionable, Jefferson/Addison questionable, Daniels starts with Diggs out, Breece Hall out, Surtain/Moss out and Bryant IR. CAR (bye) and HOU fully quiet; KC bye thin; TEN only a staff move. Dropped mostly cross-club leftovers (Kalshi division odds, WSH-fan NFC East debate, CFB recruiting, Oklahoma State helmets), college, NBA/NHL/MLB/F1/WNBA/NASCAR, merch, cheerleaders, Hulu drama, Minneapolis Miracle and Snow Bowl nostalgia, Tyreek Hill divorce trial, near-dupes.

items.title: Fans blast Bickley for defending Brissett amid 1-3 start
items.one_line: Radio host says Cardinals' issues go beyond Jacoby Brissett; fans push back as rookie Carson Beck looms and LaFleur keeps Brissett as starter.

items.title: Rookie RB Jeremiyah Love eyes full availability vs. Lions
items.one_line: Love was limited with ankle 'maintenance'; LaFleur expects no impact on his role Sunday vs. Detroit.

items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. brushes off trade buzz
items.one_line: New agents sparked calls from teams like the Colts before the Nov. 10 deadline; Arizona says it isn't shopping him.

items.title: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson for SNF at Atlanta
items.one_line: Tyler Huntley starts for Baltimore in Atlanta Sunday night; Hendrickson and Jurgens also out.

items.title: Ravens DC Weaver plans three-LB looks vs. Falcons run game
items.one_line: Weaver may lean on Smith, Simpson and Buchanan together to counter Atlanta's rushing attack and heavy formations.

items.title: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson for SNF at Atlanta
items.one_line: Minter says Tyler Huntley starts; Trey Hendrickson (finger) and Cam Jurgens (concussion) also out.

items.title: Ravens injury report: Flowers, Hamilton limited; Humphrey sitting
items.one_line: Zay Flowers (foot) and Kyle Hamilton (groin) limited, Marlon Humphrey (hamstring/calf) out of practice as Baltimore preps for Atlanta.

items.title: DC Anthony Weaver plans more three-LB looks vs. Falcons
items.one_line: Roquan Smith, Trenton Simpson and Teddye Buchanan could share the field more to slow Atlanta's run game.

items.title: Bills prep for Rams: DJ Moore AC sprain, Benford back stretching
items.one_line: Moore limited with a shoulder sprain; Benford (toe) returning; Ed Oliver and Dee Alford sat parts of Thursday practice before MNF vs. LAR.

items.title: Orchard Park residents push back on development near new Highmark Stadium
items.one_line: Most of 30-plus town-hall speakers opposed hotels and bars near the $2.1B stadium; board hasn't voted.

items.title: FanDuel QB tier list puts Josh Allen alone at the top
items.one_line: Allen gets his own tier, sparking debate over where Prescott, Nix, Herbert and Mahomes land.

items.title: Bears legend Mike Ditka dies at 86
items.one_line: Tributes pour in from the Bears, NFL coaches and presidents; Lambeau plans a pregame tribute before Bears-Packers.

items.title: Bears-Packers heats up with Tyson Bagent starting for Caleb Williams
items.one_line: 3-1 Chicago goes to Lambeau with Bagent under center; Micah Parsons says the Bears are lucky he's out.

items.title: Monangai turf toe, Swift limited, Caleb still not practicing
items.one_line: Kyle Monangai missed a second straight practice (thumb/turf toe); Williams' hamstring progressing but no practice yet.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins questionable for Miami
items.one_line: Both practiced fully Friday but carry questionable tags (Chase concussion, Higgins groin/neck); Cook, Bozeman and Young also questionable.

items.title: Bengals fans want fines for Jaguars hits on Chase
items.one_line: Jarrian Jones' face-mask twist and Ventrell Miller's high hit on Chase from the Jacksonville loss spark a dirty-play debate.

items.title: Browns rule out Mason Graham, Mike Hall Jr. and five more vs. Jets
items.one_line: DTs Graham and Hall Jr., Kalia Davis, Dillon Gabriel, Teven Jenkins, Carsen Ryan and Tylan Wallace are out, thinning DT and TE depth.

items.title: Todd Monken in early Coach of the Year mix
items.one_line: Kalshi has the Browns' Monken at 14%, behind Ben Johnson and Klint Kubiak.

items.title: Buccaneers stun Cowboys 24-16 on TNF
items.one_line: Winless Tampa Bay won at AT&T Stadium behind Bucky Irving's 165 rushing yards and a 72-yard TD; Dallas falls to 2-3 after a failed late two-point try.

items.title: Dak Prescott confronts stadium worker who called loss 'embarrassing'
items.one_line: Video shows Prescott pointing the worker out in the tunnel after the TB loss.

items.title: Cowboys pass defense ranks last in key metrics under Christian Parker
items.one_line: Dallas is 32nd in EPA per pass play and passer rating allowed (120.9) with zero interceptions; fans revisit the Micah Parsons trade.

items.title: Sean Payton takes back play-calling from Davis Webb
items.one_line: After a 2-2 start with bottom-ranked scoring, Payton calls plays starting this week vs. the Chargers; Webb called it 'not ideal.'

items.title: Broncos put Pat Bryant on IR; Surtain and Moss ruled out
items.one_line: Lil'Jordan Humphrey promoted to the 53 and Ugo Amadi signed to the practice squad before the Chargers game.

items.title: Lions rule out Branch, Mays, Ya-Sin and Bartch at Arizona
items.one_line: Final report has Brian Branch and Cade Mays out (activation planned after the bye), Rock Ya-Sin and Ben Bartch out, Tyleik Williams questionable.

items.title: DC Kelvin Sheppard defends last-ranked defense in fiery presser
items.one_line: After allowing 329 passing yards to Bryce Young, Sheppard called the offense-must-carry talk 'ultra disrespectful' and demanded real change.

items.title: Packers promote Pierre Strong Jr., put Warren Brinson on IR
items.one_line: RB depth move with Chris Brooks (ankle) missing practice before the Bears game.

items.title: Bears-Packers heats up as Micah Parsons says Chicago is lucky he's out
items.one_line: Parsons is sidelined for the Lambeau rivalry game; Chicago starts Tyson Bagent.

items.title: Steelers rule out Pittman, Dean and Elliott vs. Colts
items.one_line: Pittsburgh's report has Jalen Ramsey and Rico Dowdle questionable for the Indianapolis game.

items.title: Eagles rule out Barkley, DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown for London vs. Jaguars
items.one_line: Epps and Drew Kendall also out, Greenard questionable; Hurts added with a calf but practiced fully and is expected to play.

items.title: Jarrian Jones and Ventrell Miller hits on Ja'Marr Chase draw fine calls
items.one_line: Bengals fans want the league to fine the two Jaguars over a face-mask twist and a high hit in Jacksonville's win.

items.title: Chiefs lead race to bring back Tyreek Hill
items.one_line: Hill's agent expects a signing within days; Rice and Thornton injuries make KC the frontrunner, with Mahomes and Kelce on board.

items.title: Rookie edge Jalon Walker's rough debut vs. Miami draws scrutiny
items.one_line: Clips contrast Walker struggling against blocks with Dolphins rookie Jon Eric Sullivan's pass rush.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty downgraded to limited before Patriots game
items.one_line: Ankle and foot issues; Brock Bowers and Jackson Powers-Johnson practiced fully as 3-1 Las Vegas heads to Foxborough.

items.title: Klint Kubiak near the top of early Coach of the Year odds
items.one_line: Kalshi has Kubiak at 15%, just behind Ben Johnson.

items.title: Chargers rule out Derwin James, Joe Alt, Quentin Johnston and four more vs. Denver
items.one_line: Awosika, Donte Jackson, Penning and Brenen Thompson also out; McConkey questionable and Trey Lance doubtful.

items.title: Rashawn Slater to IR after tight-rope ankle surgery
items.one_line: High-ankle sprain from the Seattle game leaves LA without both starting tackles.

items.title: OC Mike McDaniel owns the heat after 0-4 start
items.one_line: Offense is 28th in scoring; Harbaugh backs him as Derwin James and Quentin Johnston trade talk builds.

items.title: Bills injury picture ahead of MNF at the Rams
items.one_line: Buffalo's DJ Moore is limited with an AC joint sprain and Christian Benford is working back from a toe injury before Monday in LA.

items.title: Dolphins rule out Caleb Douglas, Rob Beal, Reese Taylor and Justin Joly vs. Cincinnati
items.one_line: Kenneth Grant, Storm Duck and Jaylen Wright questionable; Bengals' Chase and Higgins also questionable.

items.title: Bengals' Jordan Battle says Malik Willis taps the ball before throws
items.one_line: Battle publicly flagged a pre-throw tell from Miami's QB ahead of Sunday at Hard Rock Stadium.

items.title: Rookie Jon Eric Sullivan's pass rush wins over doubters
items.one_line: Clips of his stutter-step rush vs. Kansas City are circulating.

items.title: Jefferson and Addison questionable, Darrisaw out vs. Saints
items.one_line: Final report also lists Brian O'Neill and Michael Jurgens questionable and Charles Demmings out.

items.title: Starting CBs Gonzalez and Davis miss second straight practice
items.one_line: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis (neck) DNP; Rhamondre Stevenson limited before the Raiders game.

items.title: Brenden Schooler expected off NFI list for season debut
items.one_line: Vrabel says the special-teamer will fill the open 53-man spot vs. Las Vegas.

items.title: Chris Olave limited with new foot issue; Kamara limited (back)
items.one_line: Olave sat Wednesday after a late hit vs. Atlanta, then returned limited Thursday before the Vikings game.

items.title: DC Brandon Staley fires back at Troy Aikman
items.one_line: Staley said Aikman has 'no idea what he's talking about' after Atlanta ran for 205 yards; Kaden Elliss is out vs. Minnesota.

items.title: Malik Nabers ready for Washington with no injury tag
items.one_line: Harbaugh says Nabers will play after knee soreness; Chauncey Golston and Jason Pinnock are out.

items.title: Giants lead NFC East at 3-1 behind Winston and the defense
items.one_line: Jameis Winston has kept them winning since Jaxson Dart's knee injury; fans credit the culture under John Harbaugh.

items.title: Jets rule out Breece Hall vs. Cleveland
items.one_line: Hall is out alongside others while the Browns are without Mason Graham and Mike Hall Jr.

items.title: Eagles rule out Barkley, DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown for London
items.one_line: Epps and Drew Kendall also out, Greenard questionable; Hurts (calf) practiced fully and is expected to play vs. Jacksonville.

items.title: Eagles cut Andy Dalton, promote Jake Majors and Carson Steele
items.one_line: Center and RB depth adds for London; Tanner McKee and Cole Payton back up Hurts.

items.title: Jalen Hurts under fire after 2-2 start and roster shakeup
items.one_line: Lane Johnson's retirement and the Cam Jurgens trade leave a young line; Chris Long and Nick Foles weigh in.

items.title: Steelers rule out Pittman, Dean and Elliott vs. Colts
items.one_line: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, multiple weeks), Jamel Dean (ankle) and DeShon Elliott (knee, IR) out; Jalen Ramsey and Rico Dowdle questionable.

items.title: Jalen Ramsey says there's a disconnect in the secondary
items.one_line: Ramsey's post-practice remarks about players and coaches spread fast and drew a clarification.

items.title: 4-0 49ers and Purdy head to Seattle for NFC West clash
items.one_line: Mike Macdonald's defense beat San Francisco twice last season; Kalshi has SEA at 30% for the division.

items.title: Leonard Williams sits with ankle tweak
items.one_line: Seahawks DT missed practice ahead of the 49ers game as SF gets Mykel Williams back.

items.title: Nick Bosa out again, not traveling to Seattle
items.one_line: Bosa (calf) misses a third straight game but says he's 'pretty darn likely' for Week 6 MNF vs. Washington.

items.title: Mykel Williams set for season debut vs. Seahawks
items.one_line: Shanahan says the first-rounder is ready after his ACL recovery, bolstering a pass rush without Bosa.

items.title: Brock Purdy's sack-free 4-0 start fuels MVP talk
items.one_line: Purdy leads the league in Total QBR and is tied for the lead with 11 TD passes.

items.title: Buccaneers stun Cowboys 24-16 for first win
items.one_line: Rookie Jalon Daniels threw for 189 and a TD, and Bucky Irving ran for 165 and two scores, cooling the Todd Bowles hot seat talk.

items.title: Titans fire three business-side executives behind the rebrand
items.one_line: SVPs Adam Nuse and Erin Swartz and creative VP Charles Jensen are out in a restructure as Tennessee sits 0-4.

items.title: Jayden Daniels starts vs. Giants; Diggs and Mariota out
items.one_line: Quinn confirms Daniels (elbow) starts; Nick Cross and Charles Omenihu also out, Terry McLaurin and Trey Amos questionable.

items.title: Lucas Patrick named starting center over Nick Allegretti
items.one_line: Quinn made the change at center going forward.

items.title: Commanders waive rookie RB Kaytron Allen
items.one_line: Washington hopes to bring the Penn State rushing leader back on the practice squad after he clears waivers.
